paras.text: Exercise
paras.urdu: مشق
paras.pashto: تمرین

paras.text: 1.1 Write T for true and F for false statement.
paras.urdu: 1.1 درست بیان کے لیے T اور غلط کے لیے F لکھیں۔
paras.pashto: 1.1 د سم بیان لپاره T او د ناسم لپاره F ولیکئ.

paras.text: i. The range of probability is from zero to one.
paras.urdu: i. احتمال کی حد صفر سے ایک تک ہے۔
paras.pashto: i. د احتمال حد له صفر څخه تر یو پورې دی.

paras.text: ii. An event which contains only one sample point is called compound event.
paras.urdu: ii. وہ واقعہ جس میں صرف ایک نمونہ نقطہ ہو، مرکب واقعہ کہلاتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: ii. هغه پېښه چې یوازې یو نمونوي ټکی ولري، مرکبه پېښه بلل کېږي.

paras.text: iii. Events which cannot occur at a time are called not mutually exclusive events.
paras.urdu: iii. وہ واقعات جو ایک وقت میں واقع نہ ہو سکیں، غیر باہم مانع واقعات کہلاتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: iii. هغه پېښې چې په یو وخت رامنځته نه شي، نه یو بل منع کوونکې پېښې بلل کېږي.

paras.text: iv. When a die is rolled four time, the number of sample points in the sample space will be 1296.
paras.urdu: iv. جب ایک پانسہ چار بار پھینکا جائے تو نمونہ فضا میں نمونہ نقاط کی تعداد 1296 ہوگی۔
paras.pashto: iv. کله چې یو ډایس څلور ځله واچول شي، نو په نمونوي فضا کې د نمونوي ټکو شمېر به 1296 وي.

paras.text: v. Two events are mutually exclusive if they have no outcomes in common.
paras.urdu: v. دو واقعات باہم مانع ہوتے ہیں اگر ان میں کوئی نتیجہ مشترک نہ ہو۔
paras.pashto: v. دوه پېښې یو بل منع کوونکې وي که هېڅ ګډه پایله ونه لري.

paras.text: vi. A and B are mutually exclusive events if $P(A\text{ and }B)=P(A)\,P(B)$
paras.urdu: vi. A اور B باہم مانع واقعات ہیں اگر $P(A\text{ and }B)=P(A)\,P(B)$
paras.pashto: vi. A او B یو بل منع کوونکې پېښې دي که $P(A\text{ and }B)=P(A)\,P(B)$

paras.text: vii. When two events are independent, the occurrence of one event will not change the probability of the second event.
paras.urdu: vii. جب دو واقعات آزاد ہوں تو ایک واقعہ کا وقوع دوسرے واقعہ کے احتمال کو تبدیل نہیں کرے گا۔
paras.pashto: vii. کله چې دوه پېښې خپلواکې وي، د یوې پېښې رامنځته کېدل به د دویمې پېښې احتمال بدل نه کړي.

paras.text: viii. The probability of drawing a red card form pack of 52 cards is $\frac{26}{52}$.
paras.urdu: viii. 52 پتوں کی گڈی سے سرخ پتا نکالنے کا احتمال $\frac{26}{52}$ ہے۔
paras.pashto: viii. د 52 کارتونو له ګډۍ څخه د سور کارت د راایستلو احتمال $\frac{26}{52}$ دی.

paras.text: ix. Probability of an event will never be negative.
paras.urdu: ix. کسی واقعہ کا احتمال کبھی منفی نہیں ہوگا۔
paras.pashto: ix. د یوې پېښې احتمال به هېڅکله منفي نه وي.

paras.text: x. The complementary events are always not-mutually exclusive events.
paras.urdu: x. تکمیلی واقعات ہمیشہ غیر باہم مانع واقعات ہوتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: x. بشپړوونکې پېښې تل نه یو بل منع کوونکې پېښې وي.

paras.text: 1.2 Fill in the suitable word in the blanks.
paras.urdu: 1.2 خالی جگہوں میں مناسب لفظ بھریں۔
paras.pashto: 1.2 په تشو ځایونو کې مناسبه کلمه ولیکئ.

paras.text: (i) An event which cannot occur is known as ______ event.
paras.urdu: (i) جو واقعہ واقع نہ ہو سکے اسے ______ واقعہ کہتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: (i) هغه پېښه چې رامنځته نه شي، ______ پېښه بلل کېږي.

paras.text: (ii) Totality of all possible outcomes of a random experiment is called ______
paras.urdu: (ii) کسی تصادفی تجربے کے تمام ممکنہ نتائج کی کلیت کو ______ کہتے ہیں
paras.pashto: (ii) د یوې تصادفي تجربې د ټولو شونو پایلو مجموعې ته ______ وایي

paras.text: (iii) An orderly arrangements of r distinct things out of n are called ______
paras.urdu: (iii) n میں سے r مختلف چیزوں کی مرتب ترتیبات کو ______ کہتے ہیں
paras.pashto: (iii) له n څخه د r بېلابېلو شیانو منظمو ترتیبونو ته ______ وایي

paras.text: (iv) The limits of probability are from ______
paras.urdu: (iv) احتمال کی حدیں ______ ہیں
paras.pashto: (iv) د احتمال حدونه ______ دي

paras.text: (v) The need for probability was originally felt in ______
paras.urdu: (v) احتمال کی ضرورت ابتدا میں ______ میں محسوس ہوئی
paras.pashto: (v) احتمال ته اړتیا په پیل کې په ______ کې احساس شوه

paras.text: (vi) $P(A\cup B)$ can be expressed by the ______ law of probability.
paras.urdu: (vi) $P(A\cup B)$ کو احتمال کے ______ قانون سے ظاہر کیا جا سکتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: (vi) $P(A\cup B)$ د احتمال د ______ قانون په واسطه ښودل کېدای شي.

paras.text: (vii) If two events A and B are disjoint, the $P(A\cup B)=$ ______
paras.urdu: (vii) اگر دو واقعات A اور B منفصل ہوں تو $P(A\cup B)=$ ______
paras.pashto: (vii) که دوه پېښې A او B بېلې وي، نو $P(A\cup B)=$ ______

paras.text: (viii) If $P(A\cap B)=P(A)\,P(B)$, then events A and B are ______
paras.urdu: (viii) اگر $P(A\cap B)=P(A)\,P(B)$ ہو تو واقعات A اور B ______ ہیں
paras.pashto: (viii) که $P(A\cap B)=P(A)\,P(B)$ وي، نو A او B پېښې ______ دي

paras.text: (ix) If $\overline{A}$ is the compliment of A, the probability of $\overline{A}$ is equal to ______
paras.urdu: (ix) اگر $\overline{A}$ واقعہ A کا تکملہ ہو تو $\overline{A}$ کا احتمال ______ کے برابر ہے
paras.pashto: (ix) که $\overline{A}$ د A بشپړوونکې وي، نو د $\overline{A}$ احتمال له ______ سره برابر دی

paras.text: (x) The probability of obtaining a total of 7 in single throw of two dice is ______
paras.urdu: (x) دو پانسوں کو ایک بار پھینکنے میں کل 7 آنے کا احتمال ______ ہے
paras.pashto: (x) د دوو ډایسونو په یو ځل اچولو کې د ټولټال 7 د ترلاسه کولو احتمال ______ دی

paras.text: 1.3 Choose the correct answer.

paras.pashto: 1.3 سم ځواب وټاکئ.

paras.urdu: (ii) احتمال ظاہر کیا جاتا ہے بطور

paras.text: (iii) When two events cannot happen simultaneously in a single trial, the events are said to be
paras.urdu: (iii) جب ایک ہی آزمائش میں دو واقعات بیک وقت واقع نہ ہو سکیں تو واقعات کہلاتے ہیں
paras.pashto: (iii) کله چې په یوه ازمېښت کې دوه پېښې په یو وخت رامنځته نه شي، پېښې بلل کېږي

paras.text: (a) dependent  (b) equally likely
paras.urdu: (a) تابع  (b) مساوی امکان والے

paras.text: (c) mutually Exclusive  (d) independent

paras.text: (iv) An event consisting of those elements, which are not in A is called
paras.urdu: (iv) ان عناصر پر مشتمل واقعہ جو A میں نہیں، کہلاتا ہے
paras.pashto: (iv) هغه پېښه چې د هغو عناصرو څخه جوړه وي چې په A کې نه دي، بلل کېږي

paras.text: (v) If A is an event, the conditional probability of A given A is equal to
paras.urdu: (v) اگر A ایک واقعہ ہو تو A دیا ہونے پر A کا مشروط احتمال برابر ہے
paras.pashto: (v) که A یوه پېښه وي، د A په شرط د A شرطي احتمال برابر دی له

paras.pashto: (vi) که یوه سکه درې ځله واچول شي، نو د تر ټولو زیات یو سر د ترلاسه کولو احتمال برابر دی له

paras.urdu: (vii) دو منصفانہ پانسوں سے جفت مجموعہ آنے کا احتمال ہے

paras.pashto: (viii) په عادلانه ډایس د شپږو احتمال $1/6$ دی. د شپږو نه راتلو احتمال دی

paras.text: (ix) $P(A)+P(\overline{A})$ is equal to
paras.urdu: (ix) $P(A)+P(\overline{A})$ برابر ہے

paras.urdu: (x) ایک منصفانہ پانسہ اور ایک منصفانہ سکہ ایک ساتھ پھینکے جاتے ہیں۔ مشترکہ نتائج کی تعداد ہے
paras.pashto: (x) یو عادلانه ډایس او یوه عادلانه سکه یوځای اچول کېږي. د ګډو پایلو شمېر دی

sections.theory:
Exercise

1.1 Write T for true and F for false statement.

i. The range of probability is from zero to one.

ii. An event which contains only one sample point is called compound event.

iii. Events which cannot occur at a time are called not mutually exclusive events.

iv. When a die is rolled four time, the number of sample points in the sample space will be 1296.

v. Two events are mutually exclusive if they have no outcomes in common.

vi. A and B are mutually exclusive events if P(A\text{ and }B)=P(A)\,P(B)

vii. When two events are independent, the occurrence of one event will not change the probability of the second event.

viii. The probability of drawing a red card form pack of 52 cards is \frac{26}{52}.

ix. Probability of an event will never be negative.

x. The complementary events are always not-mutually exclusive events.

1.2 Fill in the suitable word in the blanks.

(i) An event which cannot occur is known as ______ event.

(ii) Totality of all possible outcomes of a random experiment is called ______

(iii) An orderly arrangements of r distinct things out of n are called ______

(iv) The limits of probability are from ______

(v) The need for probability was originally felt in ______

(vi) P(A\cup B) can be expressed by the ______ law of probability.

(vii) If two events A and B are disjoint, the P(A\cup B)= ______

(viii) If P(A\cap B)=P(A)\,P(B), then events A and B are ______

(ix) If \overline{A} is the compliment of A, the probability of \overline{A} is equal to ______

(x) The probability of obtaining a total of 7 in single throw of two dice is ______

1.3 Choose the correct answer.

(i) The probability of an event A lies between

(a) −1 and +1  (b) −1 and 0

(c) 0 and 1  (d) +1 and −1

(ii) Probability is expressed as

(a) ratio  (b) proportion

(c) percentage  (d) all of the above

(iii) When two events cannot happen simultaneously in a single trial, the events are said to be

(a) dependent  (b) equally likely

(c) mutually Exclusive  (d) independent

(iv) An event consisting of those elements, which are not in A is called

(a) primary event  (b) derived event

(c) simple event  (d) complementary event

(v) If A is an event, the conditional probability of A given A is equal to

(a) zero  (b) one

(c) \infty  (d) 0.8

(vi) If a coin is tossed three times, then the probability of getting at most one head is equal to

(a) 3/8  (b) 7/8

(c) 1/2  (d) 1/8

(vii) The probability of throwing an even sum with two fair dice is

(a) 1/4  (b) 1/16

(c) 1  (d) 1/2

(viii) The probability of six on a fair die is 1/6. The probability of not six is

(a) 2/6  (b) 5/6

(c) 1/2  (d) 6/6

(ix) P(A)+P(\overline{A}) is equal to

(a) 0  (b) \infty

(c) 1  (d) 0.5

(x) A fair die and a fair coin are thrown at a time. The number of combined outcomes is

(a) 6  (b) 12

(c) 2  (d) 8

sections.content:
Exercise

1.1 Write T for true and F for false statement.

i. The range of probability is from zero to one.

ii. An event which contains only one sample point is called compound event.

iii. Events which cannot occur at a time are called not mutually exclusive events.

iv. When a die is rolled four time, the number of sample points in the sample space will be 1296.

v. Two events are mutually exclusive if they have no outcomes in common.

vi. A and B are mutually exclusive events if P(A\text{ and }B)=P(A)\,P(B)

vii. When two events are independent, the occurrence of one event will not change the probability of the second event.

viii. The probability of drawing a red card form pack of 52 cards is \frac{26}{52}.

ix. Probability of an event will never be negative.

x. The complementary events are always not-mutually exclusive events.

1.2 Fill in the suitable word in the blanks.

(i) An event which cannot occur is known as ______ event.

(ii) Totality of all possible outcomes of a random experiment is called ______

(iii) An orderly arrangements of r distinct things out of n are called ______

(iv) The limits of probability are from ______

(v) The need for probability was originally felt in ______

(vi) P(A\cup B) can be expressed by the ______ law of probability.

(vii) If two events A and B are disjoint, the P(A\cup B)= ______

(viii) If P(A\cap B)=P(A)\,P(B), then events A and B are ______

(ix) If \overline{A} is the compliment of A, the probability of \overline{A} is equal to ______

(x) The probability of obtaining a total of 7 in single throw of two dice is ______

1.3 Choose the correct answer.

(i) The probability of an event A lies between

(a) −1 and +1  (b) −1 and 0

(c) 0 and 1  (d) +1 and −1

(ii) Probability is expressed as

(a) ratio  (b) proportion

(c) percentage  (d) all of the above

(iii) When two events cannot happen simultaneously in a single trial, the events are said to be

(a) dependent  (b) equally likely

(c) mutually Exclusive  (d) independent

(iv) An event consisting of those elements, which are not in A is called

(a) primary event  (b) derived event

(c) simple event  (d) complementary event

(v) If A is an event, the conditional probability of A given A is equal to

(a) zero  (b) one

(c) \infty  (d) 0.8

(vi) If a coin is tossed three times, then the probability of getting at most one head is equal to

(a) 3/8  (b) 7/8

(c) 1/2  (d) 1/8

(vii) The probability of throwing an even sum with two fair dice is

(a) 1/4  (b) 1/16

(c) 1  (d) 1/2

(viii) The probability of six on a fair die is 1/6. The probability of not six is

(a) 2/6  (b) 5/6

(c) 1/2  (d) 6/6

(ix) P(A)+P(\overline{A}) is equal to

(a) 0  (b) \infty

(c) 1  (d) 0.5

(x) A fair die and a fair coin are thrown at a time. The number of combined outcomes is

(a) 6  (b) 12

(c) 2  (d) 8
